name: Su Lingyan
source:
A courtesan who never offered bed services. She was an artist with a natural talent for writing poems, drawing, and playing different instruments. Su Lingyan was so famous that people from the whole empire traveled to see her performances. 
The night of the 15th year of Chongzhen, she ended her life by jumping from the Twenty-four Bridge into the cold waters.
translation:
A courtesan who never offered bed services. She was an artist with a natural talent for writing poems, drawing, and playing different instruments. Su Lingyan was so famous that people from the whole empire traveled to see her performances.
